note: Whole classes of questions the new route cannot answer from World Bank or Eurostat tables, refused by the knowledge group from the question's words before any search (l5geo::scope_refused_zh; user 11-08 item 1). Blanks are removed first, then every `not` word is blanked out, then a class matches when one of its rules does: `words` (a word in the question), `gaps` ([a, b, n]: a, then b within n characters after it), `joined` (a measure, a joining word, a measure: each side ends with one of `suffixes`, the right one within `max` characters), `month_numbers` (a month written as a number before 月, or a quarter code Q1-Q4), `future_year` (a four-digit year after this year). A word starting with 年 (年后) is no hit right after a four-digit year before this year (2008年以后 asks from a past year on); a `joined` pair whose two sides name the same words after a place or a year (德国失业率和法国失业率, 2000年的失业率和2023年的失业率; the place words are the knowledge group's country names, short names, group and region words) names one measure twice and is no hit (l5geo::measure_after_place). The `not` words include the World Bank official names' own uses of the words (道路交通伤害造成的死亡率, 与能源相关的甲烷排放, 6个月以下儿童). The first class in this order that matches is the one refused; reason_zh is the sentence the stop says.
